mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a canonical twenty-six-period Volume Ratio crossing its neutral 100 centerline on completed four-hour BTC auctions identifies a change in whether gross up-close or down-close participation dominates; follow the new participation side for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long on a strict upward crossing of 100 and short on a strict downward crossing of 100
mechanism.why_distinct: HVVRAT separately sums gross base volume on up-close and down-close auctions, allocates half of unchanged-close volume to each side, and takes their rolling ratio. Unlike VZO it has finite rectangular memory rather than EMA signed-net normalization; unlike OBV it is not cumulative; unlike CVD it uses close direction rather than taker classification. It uses no OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event, repair, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%, focusing participation-balance changes on July-like volatile conditions
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour rolling gross up/down participation-ratio crossings are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T), with strictly positive summed base volume
features.direction: strict sign of current completed close minus immediately prior completed close
features.up_volume: full base volume when direction positive, else zero
features.down_volume: full base volume when direction negative, else zero
features.unchanged_volume: full base volume when direction zero, else zero
features.volume_ratio: 100*(rolling26 up_volume + 0.5 rolling26 unchanged_volume)/(rolling26 down_volume + 0.5 rolling26 unchanged_volume), finite positive denominator
features.event: strict Volume Ratio crossing of 100 from immediately prior finite state
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical Volume Ratio(26) neutral-center crossing under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no Volume Ratio period, allocation, formula, centerline, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.fixed_definition: 26 completed periods; numerator=sum up-close base volume plus half unchanged-close volume; denominator=sum down-close base volume plus half unchanged-close volume; ratio=100*numerator/denominator; neutral centerline 100
external_basis.selection_use: published period, gross-side allocation, ratio, centerline, and direction only; no incidence or outcomes
